semantics.observation_scope: self-observation only: the instance signer must equal the observer
semantics.rarity: prefer an instance rolled quality when present, otherwise use the resolved item-definition quality; only signable rare-or-better qualities continue
semantics.profession: the caller resolves recipeForResultItem and the item definition; the returned profession must be either active major
semantics.mutation: a successful observation adds the fixed trickle to the recipe profession skill and no rejection mutates skill
